info.description: Backend API for the Vipin LMS platform.
info.title: Vipin LMS API

post.description: Authenticates a user and sets access_token and refresh_token as HttpOnly cookies.

400.description: Malformed payload or missing required fields

post.description:
Reads the refresh_token cookie and issues new access_token and refresh_token cookies.
The refresh_token cookie is sent automatically by the browser after login/register.

400.description: Missing/invalid refresh token or user not found

post.description: Creates a student account and sets access_token and refresh_token as HttpOnly cookies.

400.description: Malformed payload or missing required fields

get.description: Admin only. Returns all courses that are not deleted, newest first.

post.description: Admin only. Creates a course for an instructor. Status defaults to draft.

get.description: Returns the course's lessons (chapters) in order, each with its PDF notes. Only the course instructor and enrolled students can see it. Students see published lessons only.
get.summary: List a course's lessons with their notes

post.description: Instructor adds a lesson to a course they teach. A lesson is a chapter: add as many PDF notes to it as needed with POST /lessons/{id}/notes. It goes at the end of the course and is published by default.

403.description: Not the instructor of this course

get.description: Returns the PDF notes of a course, newest first, optionally for one lesson. For notes grouped by lesson use GET /courses/{id}/lessons. Only the course instructor and enrolled students can see them.

patch.description: Instructor only. Changes the status of a course the instructor teaches.

get.description: Admin only. Newest first. Filter by courseId and/or userId.

post.description: Admin only. Enrolls a student in a published course for a number of months (1 to 60). The expiry date is calculated by the server.

400.description: Malformed payload, bad student, or course not published

patch.description: Admin only. For example set an enrollment to cancelled.

get.description: Returns all active exams, sorted by code. Any logged-in user can call this.

post.description: Instructor uploads a PDF note to a lesson of a course they teach. Max 25 MB.
post.summary: Share a PDF note on a lesson

400.description: Invalid form, file is not a PDF, or too large

404.description: Lesson not found, or not in a course this user teaches

503.description: File storage is disabled (GCS_ENABLE is not true)

delete.description: Instructor deletes a note they uploaded. The PDF is removed too.

503.description: File storage is disabled (GCS_ENABLE is not true)

get.description: Streams the PDF. Only the course instructor and enrolled students can download it.

404.description: Note not found, or not visible to this user

503.description: File storage is disabled (GCS_ENABLE is not true)

get.description: Returns posts from free courses, courses the user is enrolled in, and courses the user teaches. Newest first.

post.description: Instructor creates a post (with optional links) for one of their own courses.

403.description: Not an instructor of this course

delete.description: Instructor deletes a post they created. Its links are deleted too.

months.description: how long the enrollment lasts, like 3
